question: What physical conditions are removed from one who attains this nectar?
premises: The practitioner becomes freed from wrinkles and gray hair.
The practitioner becomes devoid of all diseases.
These states result from the described attainment.
inference: Attaining this nectar renders the practitioner free from wrinkles, gray hair, and all diseases.
plain_english: One becomes freed from wrinkles and gray hair, and devoid of all diseases.
